title: Fetch
explain: The `fetch()` function lets you request data from the internet (like getting information from a web server). It returns a Promise, which means you need to use `.then()` or `async/await` to handle the response. The response needs to be converted to usable data using methods like `.json()` for JSON data.
exercise: Modify the code to fetch from 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users/1' instead and log only the `name` property of the user.
tip: Don't forget to call `.json()` on the response—many beginners try to use the response object directly without converting it to actual data.
